notes: Gaan is one of the most common verbs in Dutch, used both for physical movement and as an auxiliary verb to form the future tense (e.g., 'ik ga eten' - I am going to eat).
Do not confuse it with 'lopen', which specifically means to walk; 'gaan' is about moving from one place to another, regardless of the method of transport.

senses.definition: To move from one place to another; to travel.
